svg.title: Butler hands work off and keeps talking
svg.desc: A Butler window. You ask Butler to go through a project and summarize this week's changes. Butler hands the task to a Steward, which works in the background and shows its progress above the composer. Meanwhile you ask what 15% of 84 is and Butler answers right away. When the Steward finishes, Butler posts the weekly summary in the same conversation.

g.text: Go through this project and summarize this week's changes
I've handed this to a Steward. It works in the background, so keep chatting. I'll post the summary
The Steward finished. This week in Home:
